title: GLP-1 receptor agonist for type 2 diabetes (e.g., semaglutide)
note: Synthetic, simplified policy for research use. Modeled on common criteria patterns; not any real insurer's policy and not clinical guidance.

criteria.text: Patient has a diagnosis of type 2 diabetes mellitus.
Patient is 18 years of age or older.
Most recent HbA1c is 7.0% or higher, measured within the last 90 days.
Patient has tried metformin for at least 90 days.
Absence of personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma is documented.
